title: Credential delivery
text: The terminal waits while authorization is pending, then finishes on one-time credential consumption, denial or expiry. The engine owns personal decisions and atomically issues and consumes the credential; only one successful poll receives the raw token. Hosted machine_authorization.handoff_poll uses the original device secret and explicit engine org_id under service-only authority, avoiding a shared proxy-address admission bucket. Network loss after delivery requires a fresh connection; credentials cannot be replayed. An install below the handoff serving floor names the control-plane operator rollout recovery. Consumer source adoption is observed; production approval and delivery proof remain pending.
